summary: A notice from the Network Information Center that the ARC PDP-10 system at SRI would be unavailable from Friday, November 17 to Sunday, November 26, 1972, for hardware work. It explains the schedule and says a login message will remind users.

plainLanguage.summary: The Network Information Center announced that the ARC PDP-10 would be unavailable for hardware work over Thanksgiving week. The RFC gives the expected outage dates and describes the planned maintenance.

subtitle: Planned Thanksgiving maintenance for the ARC system

tldr.problem: The ARC PDP-10 needed a period of hardware work that would make it unavailable to ARC and NIC users.
tldr.mechanism: The system was scheduled to be offline from November 17 through November 26, 1972, while hardware staff worked on equipment and cabling.
tldr.outcome: The notice informed users in advance and said a login message would repeat the schedule.

today: RFC 416 is a maintenance notice for the ARC PDP-10. It records the planned downtime and the equipment work described in November 1972.

sections.title: When the ARC System Would Be Down
sections.content:
The ARC PDP-10 system would be unavailable to ARC and NIC users from Friday, November 17 at 6:00 p.m. PST through Sunday, November 26 at 10:00 p.m. PST. The notice says the schedule gave the hardware team nine days while costing users three SRI working days.

A login message was also scheduled to inform users of the downtime.
sections.plainLanguage: The ARC system was scheduled to go offline on November 17 and return on November 26. A login message would also warn users about the shutdown.

sections.title: Planned Hardware Work
sections.content: The maintenance list includes removing a Bryant disk and controller, moving display and disk-pack equipment, and changing drum power and signal cabling. Staff also planned drum maintenance and training, checks of signal levels, work on the parity checker and related cables, and construction of a wall for a disk-pack location.
sections.plainLanguage: The team planned to remove and move equipment, update cables and power connections, and test the parity checker and signal levels.

sections.title: Notice to ARC and NIC Users
sections.content: The RFC serves as the Network Information Center's notice to its users. It explains that the shutdown was for hardware work and gives users a date range for planning around the system's absence.
sections.plainLanguage: ARC and NIC users were given the schedule so they could plan around the system being unavailable.
